criterion_bindings.exemption: The corpus scenario AJ1-ambiguous-product proves read-side refusal through TestAgentJobsCorpus (internal/agent/agent_jobs_corpus_test.go). Mutation refusal before effects remains required and needs a retained mutation witness after planning retirement.

Context freshness is an envelope property below scenario grain. The guarantee is proved by TestStaleUnchangedScopePermitsReadAndRejectsMutationBeforeAnyEffect (internal/agent/context_freshness_test.go).

Replay across scope drift is a dispatch property. The guarantee is proved by TestDispatchIdempotentReplaySurvivesAmbientScopeDrift (internal/agent/mutation_dispatch_test.go) and TestMutationDigestBindsIntentNotApprovalTransportReference (internal/agent/runtime_test.go).

Approval consumption atomicity is a dispatch property. The guarantee is proved by TestDispatchApprovalChallengeRoundTripIsDurableAndSingleUse and TestDispatchFailedDomainEffectRollsBackGrantAndApproval (internal/agent/mutation_dispatch_test.go).

Cross-scope authorization is an envelope property. The guarantee is proved by TestDispatchCrossProductCaptureRequiresBoundApproval and TestDispatchCrossProductLinkRequiresCapabilityAndApproval (internal/agent/mutation_dispatch_test.go).
